metaDescription: Order custom purple pennants in bulk for your next event. Perfect for sports teams, schools, and promotions.
introHtml: Purple pennants bring a bold, regal look to any event or promotion. Whether you're outfitting a sports team, decorating for a school spirit week, or creating branded giveaways for a corporate event, purple stands out with energy and sophistication. Our custom purple pennants are screen printed with your logo or message on durable felt fabric, available in multiple sizes. The deep purple color pairs well with white, gold, or silver imprinting for high contrast. Ideal for bulk orders where consistent color and crisp decoration matter.
heroAltText: Custom purple pennants with white screen-printed logo, displayed against a dark background.
